tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Search checked facts about getting a family ready for illness or death: Medicare permission forms, Social Security, hospital stays, unclaimed money, and more. Each result has the official source, the date checked, and a guide link.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Look up an official form by code (for example CMS-10106) and get what it does in plain words, the official link, and our step-by-step guide.

tools.name: readiness_checklist
tools.description: The Family Readiness Standard: 25 checks a family should be able to pass if someone gets sick or dies, grouped by area.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List the free guides and tools on planbeforeyoudie.app with their short answers.

tools.name: after_death_deadlines
tools.description: Return the same sourced dates and conditional review checkpoints as the public calendar. It does not establish who can act or select a form.

tools.name: state_rules
tools.description: Return the complete published state row, conditions and source passages. This reference does not decide eligibility or an individual legal result.

tools.name: inherited_ira_rule
tools.description: Use the existing sourced calculator. Returns review conditions and timing. Dollar amounts require an optional prior December 31 balance. It does not choose a spouse option or an election.

tools.name: agency_permissions
tools.description: Return the published agency routes with forms, conditions, incapacity and death limits. The situation selects a reading focus and never grants authority.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_form" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
